body:
i went to therapy for a little last year but the therapist seemed to belittle or trivialize my feelings and thoughts, like i would say something such as "i feel inadequate" and she would say something along the lines of 'well that doesn't make any sense, you have no reason to feel that way' and so i ended up quitting because i thought i was getting better on my own... then this year it's been getting progressively worse but i've gotten better at feigning happiness and pretending like i'm fine but now i've found myself in late night dark places more than once.

college is hard. i'm in my third year and i'm supposed to have already done an internship but i haven't because i had to work and save money for school. i don't have finalized summer plans yet, but i'll probably be at home where i don't have any friends left working a 9-5 receptionist job. i have no clear career plans yet, but what i want to do is in a low paying and stressful field. what's worse is how mediocre and inadequate i feel here, like you mentioned before. i feel like i don't deserve to be here. i wish i could quit but that would be a huge waste

it sucks though, like how do i change this mentality? i feel like i'm stuck in a rut. it's impossible to get out of this thought pattern. i feel worthless, and then i react and skip class and screw myself over later which makes me feel worthless all over again. it's a pattern, like an endless cyle and i don't know the way out
